title: If you drank ten litres of water a day, how long until you die?
ticker: KIDNEYS CAN ONLY CLEAR ABOUT 1 LITRE OF WATER AN HOUR  •  LOW BLOOD SODIUM IS CALLED HYPONATRAEMIA  •  DOCTORS SAY: DRINK WHEN YOU'RE THIRSTY  •  2007: WOMAN DIES AFTER RADIO WATER-DRINKING CONTEST  •

lines.text: If you drank ten litres of water every single day, how long would it take for you to die?
Day one. Forty glasses of water. Your skin is glowing.
You pee every forty minutes. Your kidneys are working flat out.
Good news. Spread over the day, healthy kidneys can just about keep up. You can't overdose on water, right?
Wrong. Drink faster than about a litre an hour, and the extra water dilutes the salt in your blood.
Headaches. Nausea. Your cells swell up like water balloons. Including the ones in your brain.
Then on a hot day, you chug four litres in an hour. Your brain swells against your skull.
You died. Comment what stupid shenanigans Gary should try tomorrow.
